#!/usr/bin/python3
import os,sys
from pathlib import Path
base=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
args=sys.argv[1:]
if '-displayfd' in args:
 i=args.index('-displayfd')+1;fd=int(args[i]);os.dup2(fd,1);args[i]='1'
 if fd!=1:os.close(fd)
env=os.environ.copy();env['LD_LIBRARY_PATH']=str(base/'prefix/usr/lib64');env['LIBGL_ALWAYS_SOFTWARE']='1';env['LP_NUM_THREADS']='2'
# /usr/bin exists only in this server's unprivileged mount namespace. The
# retired host compiler is neither restored nor modified; only signed private
# xkbcomp and the host shell are visible there. App processes stay outside.
command=['/usr/bin/bwrap','--die-with-parent','--new-session','--unshare-user','--unshare-pid','--ro-bind','/','/','--bind','/tmp','/tmp','--tmpfs','/run','--ro-bind','/usr/bin','/run/dome-xvfb-host-bin','--ro-bind',str(base/'server-bin'),'/usr/bin','--',str(base/'prefix/usr/bin/Xvfb'),*args]
os.execve(command[0],command,env)
private_server.scope: Server-only unprivileged bwrap namespace, private /run tmpfs and /usr/bin mapping for signed xkbcomp; no host paths changed. App outside namespace with canonical runtime library path. Five signed RPMs downloaded, only three x86_64 payloads extracted; i686 downloads unused. DNF exclusion override command-only for download, no package installation or configuration edits.
